rules.description: Every Tier 1 concept has an approved mapping with valid CDE
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE tier = 1 AND (status != 'approved' OR cde_id IS NULL)
rules.rationale: Exact-match concepts are curated and must all be approved with a CDE assignment

rules.description: No concept maps to multiple CDEs
rules.sql: SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT cde_id) as cde_count FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE cde_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY concept HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cde_id) > 1
rules.rationale: Each XBRL concept maps to exactly one canonical CDE

rules.description: All confidence scores between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE confidence < 0.0 OR confidence > 1.0
rules.rationale: Confidence is a probability — must be in [0, 1]

rules.description: Mapped concepts (Tier 1+2) cover >= 25% of raw fact instances
rules.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.tier IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_pct FROM raw.xbrl_company_facts r LEFT JOIN base.concept_mappings m ON r.concept = m.concept WHERE r.taxonomy = 'us-gaap'
rules.rationale: 25 canonical CDEs cover core financial statement line items. The long tail of 3,000+ XBRL concepts (deferred taxes, lease details, stock compensation, etc.) are valid but not canonical CDE material at the Base zone. Actual coverage: 30.0% (163,899 of 545,421 facts). Coverage expands in Consumable zone.

rules.description: Approved mappings have valid cde_id referencing CDE catalog
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE status = 'approved' AND cde_id IS NULL
rules.rationale: Every approved mapping must point to a real CDE
